description: This is a complete HTML source file implementing a web-based database viewer interface. It includes embedded CSS styles for layout and appearance, and JavaScript code to handle dynamic data fetching, UI interactions, and rendering of database, table, and data content.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by re-fetching the data from the server.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Handles the expansion and collapse of the database's table list in the sidebar.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and displays data from a selected table, rendering it as an interactive table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs and displays an HTML table from the provided data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Provides individual cell rendering logic, handling nulls, wide content, and objects.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content or trimmed preview.
